programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

programme.title: A is for Acid
programme.desc: Murderer John George Haigh (Martin Clunes) dissolves his victims in acid.

programme.title: Nine Lives
programme.desc: A man (Wesley Snipes) must find the antidote to a mind-controlling drug.

programme.title: Calling for Love

programme.desc: Charlotte Brontë's gothic heroine (Charlotte Gainsbourg) loves her boss (William Hurt).

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: Four abandoned children turn to their grandmother (Anne Bancroft).

programme.desc: Priest (Tommy Lee Jones) sleuths with lover (Annette O'Toole) of stabbed artist.

programme.desc: Physicist Richard Feynman (Matthew Broderick) works on nuclear project.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Three wives send their husbands to Dr. Phil's Man Camp for an attitude adjustment.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: We've all heard of in-laws who don't get along, but these guests say their problems have become scary and even life-threatening.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: How to Fix a Broken Family
programme.desc: You've heard people complain, "If I only knew then what I know now, I wouldn't be in this mess," but what about those times when you choose not to see the writing on the wall? Dr. Phil meets couples who say their relationships went from bad to worse after they said, "I do," and now their families are broken.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Would you rather be right or happy? Dr. Phil talks with some right-fighters who can't settle their debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pedophiles once lurked in parks and around schoolyards, and then they prowled the playground of the World Wide Web. Now these predators have a more sinister method at their fingertips sending explicit text messages directly to your child's cell phone. Dr. Phil examines the latest technological threats to your kids and shows you how to protect them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Shot Me in the Face
programme.desc: Shot in the face, disfigured for life, the former teen victim comes face to face with the girl who pulled the trigger. Can she forgive?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a relative scheming to get money from a rich aunt, uncle or even parents when they pass away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every bride wants to shine on her special day -- from wearing the perfect gown to hosting the most extravagant reception. But what happens when the dream of the perfect wedding turns into a nightmare? Janae knows about this pain firsthand. Her husband, Michael, got so drunk before the ceremony that he passed out cold after saying “I do” and didn’t wake up until the next day! Janae attended the reception by herself and spent her wedding night with her bridesmaids at a hotel. Their wedding from hell took place two years ago, but she still tears up at the memory of that fateful day. Can she ever forgive Michael's mishaps, or is he doomed to the doghouse forever? Then, Angela is a self-professed bridezilla who makes no excuses for her demanding ways. She even created a newsletter for her bridesmaids with the rules and regulations they must follow to participate in her wedding! Her sister and maid of honor, Vanessa, worries that Angela's nitpicking will cause her fiancé, Marvin, to run for the hills. What's behind Angela's controlling behavior, and is she headed for heartache on her special day?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The contentious 2020 presidential election has shown that there’s a clear divide in America – half the country is celebrating, and the other half is angry – making the upcoming holiday season especially tricky to navigate. Instead of being a time of joy, celebration and giving thanks, many families are faced with the dilemma of how not to argue with their own spouses, children and parents about politics. Dr. Phil meets a Republican father, who is barely speaking to his Democrat daughter after an argument they had over Donald Trump. Then, Dr. Phil meets another father, a lifelong Democrat, who says he raised his son to be a free thinker ... but never imagined that he’d support Trump! The election is officially over, but the drama remains. What’s Dr. Phil’s advice on how to move forward post- election without turning holiday dinners with family into a war zone over politics? Tune in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother who is afraid of her 17-year-old son seeks help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: TV Star Nicholas Brendon has been starring in his own private alcohol-fueled drama which has led to multiple arrests and been documented in celebrity magazines, social media and blogs. Nicholas sits down with Dr. Phil -- and abruptly walks offstage. Is Nicholas ready to take the steps needed to save his life and career?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Joni claims that Gina used to be one of her besties and that they were inseparable, from spending birthday trips out of town to girls’ nights out, often ending in Gina crashing at Joni’s house. Joni says all that changed when 23- year-old Gina began dating Joni’s 49-year-old father, David, behind her back and giving birth to David’s child. Joni says she feels betrayed by Gina and her father, even going as far as sharing her dislike for her former friend and father’s newfound romance on TikTok. Gina says the picture Joni paints of them being best friends is all a lie, but in any event, Joni needs to accept her relationship with Joni’s father. David says despite his daughter’s disapproval, he is going to continue being in a committed relationship with Gina, but that doesn’t mean he can’t also have a relationship with his daughter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the last 10 years, the number of women arrested for driving drunk has risen by 30 percent, and police report that more and more young children are sitting in the back seat when these moms are pulled over.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents suspect foul play in their daughter's alleged death by suicide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Our Son is a Violent Mooch
programme.desc: A couple want to evict their violent 31-year-old son, while their son blames his parents for his financial struggles.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From marital spats to parenting disagreements, learn the biggest mistakes you're making.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: How to Get to I Do
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Teen Can’t Stand Her Stepfather
programme.desc: When he last appeared on Dr. Phil, Kip’s brazen and outrageous tirade toward his 17-year-old stepdaughter, Tory, shocked audience members and viewers. But the married father of two refused to back down. When Tory broke down in tears, Kip finally agreed to find a calmer way to express his frustration. Just weeks later, Tory’s mother, Vicky, says the surly relationship has not only gotten worse, the hostility has escalated, and her patience is running thin. She says both Tory and Kip refuse to seek help, and now there is a new bombshell that is making their home life virtually unbearable. What does Kip say is his biggest issue with his stepdaughter? And, will this family finally agree to accept help and repair what’s left of their relationship? Then, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters. One of the girls has run away, and the other feels that he treats her like a slave. Can they resolve their disputes and come together as one? (FOLLOW UP FROM 9093)

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meet a “runaway bride” who’s already called off five weddings and she’s only 26! Then, meet another guest who’s frustrated because her fiancé won’t set a wedding date. He's canceled two previous engagements and says marriage "freaks him out." What does the future hold for these two? Plus, a heartbroken woman whose fiancé called the wedding off a month before her big day. Should she wait for him to come around? Find out what every bride needs to know before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the summer of 2014, a former middle school English teacher was arrested on suspicion of statutory rape and contributing to the delinquency of a minor after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student. In a Dr. Phil exclusive, Jennifer Caswell speaks out for the first time. How does she explain her relationship with her former student?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Phyllis and Barry say they're desperate to calm their violent 15-year-old son, Brandon, and turn to Dr. Phil for help. Their requests for Brandon to perform simple tasks such as brushing his teeth or bathing cause him to go into a rage, breaking things and punching holes in walls, and even chasing Phyllis with scissors. Barry says they walk on eggshells, waiting for Brandon’s next violent outburst and that every day he leaves the house worried that his wife may not be alive when he returns. What is at the root of Brandon's anger? Dr. Phil spends some one-on-one time with the young man to determine what’s driving his behavior. And, find out what Phyllis recently found in Brandon’s room that shocked her to her core.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Sugar Babies
programme.desc: Rylee, 26, admits she’s a sugar baby and says she has no shame in dating wealthy, married men she meets online in exchange for money and lavish gifts -- and three years ago, she even convinced her mother, Tanya, to join her. Dr. Phil sits down with this mother/daughter sugar baby team, who insist they never have sex with their clients. What “services” do they say these men are paying for? And how does their family feel about their lifestyle? Then, Ashley admits she has had a side job as a sugar baby for years but has yet to tell her fiancé, Cesar -- and she wants Dr. Phil to help her confess. How will Cesar respond? And, reality TV star Kendra Wilkinson opens up about her husband, Hank Baskett’s, alleged affair with a transsexual. Does she believe the rumors? And, can her marriage survive the turmoil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel Pelosi was convicted of second-degree murder in the slaying of investment banker and multimillionaire Ted Ammon -- the husband of his lover, Generosa. He is currently serving 25 years to life but now claims he is ready to explain what really happened the night of the murder. Dr. Phil visits Pelosi behind bars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Baronica and Nathan say that on July 10, 2021, their then 9-year-old son shot his 8-year-old brother in the chest with one of six unsecured guns in their home. The parents bravely come forward to tell their story in hopes that other parents will learn from their mistakes. Then, Kristin says the last time she saw her 15-year-old son, Ethan, he was heading to his best friend’s house. Within hours, she was informed Ethan had been killed by an unsecured gun in his best friend’s house. Kristin has fought to have Ethan’s Law enacted in CT, which ensures that parents are held accountable for the safe storage of their weapons. And, hear from Susan, whose daughter Amanda was sitting on a park bench when she was shot by a group of young people, leaving her paralyzed. Plus, Ryan Busse, a former gun industry executive who says he left the industry after seeing how fear tactics were being used to sell guns, joins the conversation. This is a show every parent needs to watch -- whether you own a firearm or not.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Should They Redo Their I Dos?
programme.desc: Jaime says she divorced her allegedly abusive husband, Jay, after two years of marriage but says he refuses to let her go and lures her back with promises to change. Jay says Jaime pushes his buttons until he blows up. Can this couple save their relationship for the sake of their child, or are they better off apart?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Craig and Cherie say the last half of their 16-year marriage has been anything but happily-ever-after. Cherie says Craig is chauvinistic, verbally abusive and demands sex, which she admits she only gives him about three to four times a year. Craig says Cherie withholds sex to control him, and as a result, he has become a slave to his anger. Cherie fears the tension in their household is taking a toll on their 11-year-old daughter, who is often caught in the crossfire of their fighting. Dr. Phil challenges the couple to a communication test. Can they heal their wounds and rekindle their romance? Then, meet the couple who inspired the movie, The Vow. Shortly after Kim and Krickitt Carpenter were married, a terrible car crash changed everything. Krickitt lay in a coma for weeks, and awoke with no recognition of her husband. The couple shares their inspiring, though oftentimes heartbreaking, journey of falling in love all over again. How did they find their way back to each other? And what is it like seeing their lives played out on the big screen? If you’ve ever wondered whether love can survive the toughest of challenges, you won’t want to miss this show! This show contains strong sexual content. Viewer discretion advised.

She presses him to sort out what he wants from her, and a relationship develops. They talk of traveling. He confides in his friend, George, a poet long-married, who advises David to grow up and grow old. She invites him to meet her family. His own son, from a long-ended marriage, confronts him. Is the elegy for lost relationships, lost possibilities, beauty and time passing, or failure of nerve?

programme.title: #Clout
programme.desc: In this new social media society, followers and likes are the new social currency, where people will lie, cheat, kill, and die for attention, and fame; a combination more famously known as #CLOUT. programme.title: In This House
programme.desc: Claudia is a medical student focused on building a perfect life with her live-in boyfriend Dr. Jayson. Her grandfather’s death forces her to go back to her hometown to face her estranged family and her past. Once she arrives, she uncovers sinister secrets and will stop at nothing to break the generational curse stemming from her family’s history.

programme.title: Kingsmen
programme.desc: Follows the story of the King family, a known crime syndicate in Dallas. When the beloved patriarch is killed, they fall under the wrath of a rival crime family, as well as local law enforcement. The four eldest brothers will do everything they can to protect their family.

programme.title: Meli
programme.desc: After finding an eviction notice on her door, Meli decides it’s time to up the ante and take matters into her own hands to protect her family by any means necessary. Out of pure desperation she attempts to burglarize a stranger’s luxurious home.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Lost and grieving, Chris seeks solace in the wrong crowd. A chance encounter with the enigmatic Patrick leads him down a dangerous path, forcing him to confront his own morality and the consequences of his choices.

programme.title: She's Watching
programme.desc: Richard and Zoey have recently moved into their dream home, only to find themselves being watched by an obsessed neighbor. Watching them every night isn't enough to satisfy her urges, so she makes an offer they can't refuse.

programme.title: Murder Gardens
programme.desc: Murder Gardens is the story of Chase Washington, a 19-year-old young man whose world has been turned upside down after he leaves a comfortable home provided by his foster father for a life of crime and corruption that he's introduced to by his older brother Rell Washington. Chase ends up in the middle of a war between a notorious crew of drug dealers, corrupt politicians and local law enforcement. Determined to survive and prove that the brain is mightier than the gun, Chase finds a way to outsmart his new found enemies and keep him and his brother Rell out of prison and a graveyard.

programme.title: You Made Me This Way
programme.desc: Haunted by a failed assassination attempt, ruthless drug lord Kwame becomes obsessed with Aubrey, the woman who nearly ended his life. Consumed by revenge, he kidnaps her, setting in motion a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Deadly Squatters
programme.desc: Eugene and Laura return home from vacation to find that two young siblings have taken up residence in their home, and have now claimed legal rights as squatters. Forced to share their home with two strangers, they must play their wicked games and survive psychological terror as the legal system takes its time.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: My Plus Size Bachelorette
programme.desc: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart. With her friends rallying around her, they encourage Symone to embrace her single status and embark on a journey of self-discovery and love.

programme.title: Melted Lipstick
programme.desc: Riley Davis, a young woman in her twenties, who navigates through life fraught with insecurities about her body, self-esteem issues. Her life takes a mystical turn when she encounters an enigmatic voodoo doctor who gifts her a special lipstick, claiming that it holds the power to transform her into anyone she desires when applied. However, Riley soon learn that all magic comes for a price, as she goes down a dangerous and deadly path of destruction.

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Wish is a beautiful, confident, woman, who makes no apologies for who she is and what she does. Very sexually free, Wish goes after what she wants. If she feels like making out with a total stranger, she will. If she feels like bringing home the waitress, she will, and she will do it with the ruthlessness of a man, but with the finesse of a woman. Wish is a force to be reckoned with, until one day she meets a woman who turns her world upside down, and nothing will ever be the same.

programme.title: Triangle Slave
programme.desc: Orphaned brothers Keith and Kareem struggle in the world today after loosing their mother was murdered by their father to pay a debt. Through adversary and perseverance, they rose to become two of the biggest drug kingpins in Philadelphia. But when a woman named Sapphire comes between them, will their empire collapse under the weight of their greed and jealousy?

programme.title: An Extraordinary Measure
programme.desc: On the day that Nagasaki was bombed, the Trans Baikal and 2nd Far East Fronts of the Red Army invaded Manchuria, the 1st Far East Front moved from Vladivostok.

programme.title: Countdown to Surrender: The End
programme.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.

programme.title: Wild Dolphins
programme.desc: In the waters surrounding New Zealand live a number of dolphin species - each of which has evolved unique strategies in their family pods to survive and thrive in the different habitats around these islands in the Pacific Ocean. On the east coast of the south island off the iconic Kaikoura peninsula, an underwater canyon pushes water seething with nutrients to the surface which provides a year round banquet for huge pods of dusky dolphins. These athletic and highly social dolphins spend their nights feeding out in the canyon, and in early morning they return closer to shore where they rest socialize and play. One of their favourite activities is the “seaweed game” where individuals pass pieces of seaweed to each other practicing fancy maneuvers where they’ll catch it on their tail, dorsal or pectoral fins. Down in the south west corner of New Zealand in the majestic landscape of Fiordland live the southern-most bottlenose dolphins. At almost 4 metres long these dolphins have adapted physically to the extreme winter conditions down here by growing bigger and fatter with extra insulating blubber and evolving stubbier beaks and shorter fins and tail flukes to reduce heat loss through their extremities. These fiords are different to the coastal environment in that freshwater sits on top of the denser seawater in a distinct layer, and is much colder than the saltwater and can prove lethal to the pods’ calves in winter, so every year the bottlenose dolphins make a short migration to the outer fiords where there is less freshwater to enable their calves to survive. Off New Zealand’s north island, in the middle of the Bay of Plenty, the country’s most active volcano erupts from the sea, sending plumes of toxic gases rising skywards. In the water surrounding this volcano roam common dolphins - the nomads of the dolphin world. They are pelagic predators which mean they roam the open ocean searching for prey.

programme.title: Eagle Queen of the Skies
programme.desc: Eagles are top predators who battle fiercely for survival and work hard to raise their young. There are 60 members of the eagle clan, all united by their acute eyesight, powerful wings, sharp talons and hooked beaks. To explore the world of the eagle we follow one individual from hatching to leaving the nest and setting up a home. Her fight for survival reveals what it takes to become a queen of the sky.

programme.title: Eagle Lakes
programme.desc: The Lauenburg Lake District is located between Lübeck and Lauenburg on the River Elbe. With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border.

programme.title: Anaconda Wanted
programme.desc: Anacondas have fired people's imagination since time immemorial. Hardly any other animal is so feared and yet at the same time so revered as the biggest snake in the world.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: The gallery forests of the Serengeti are the realm of a phantom. The shadowy thickets are the domain of a Leopardess.

programme.title: Haunted Huntress
programme.desc: A brook in the Serengeti is the home of a leopardess. The secret queen of the shadows took care of her son and has done a good job so far but the adventure continues.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Human life today would be very different if our ancestors had not stopped hunting animal protein. In the Fertile Crescent - known today as the Middle East - humans travelled in nomadic groups of hunter-gatherers and ate what they killed.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: When our ancestors saw how other animals kept warm in sub-freezing temperatures, they started hunting them for their hides and fur. As hominid evolution was diverging from other primates, they lost their thick covering of fur when the mercury dropped.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: About twelve thousand years ago, before the Neolithic Revolution, humans were mainly hunter-gatherers. Among the animals we hunted were the wild aurochs, the ancestor of all domestic cattle. The domestication of cows led to the use of oxen as draught animals that could help farmers plough fields.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Throughout history, humans have surrounded themselves with animals. But there are two species that are our undeniable favourites. Every dog today was once a wolf - genetically speaking. Wolves and hominids met as early as 400,000 years ago. Ancient hunter-gatherers and wolves competed for the same prey, and used the same tracking techniques.

programme.title: Big is beautiful
programme.desc: The world is full of giants, huge creatures that fill us with awe and wonder. Some are gentle giants. Others are deadly hunters. There are different ways of defining ‘big’ - biggest in volume, or the biggest of their kind. But one thing is for sure, the huge animals of this world are fascinating, diverse and beautiful.

programme.title: Sharks of the Icy North
programme.desc: We mostly know the nimble predators from the depths of tropical seas. At the same time very little is known about the sharks of the icy North.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: For most of our history, people have fallen victim to crippling disease, and not had a clue where it came from. Despite our best efforts, we are vulnerable - not, perhaps, to lions, tigers, and bears - but more to the killers we can’t even see. In America during the early 1980s, a mysterious new disease claims the lives of 159 people, most of them gay men.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: As a species, we believe we are more than just animals. We are inspired to express ourselves through words, art, music, and scientific endeavours. Our ancestors painted animals on cave walls - usually large mammals, like bison and deer. Animals were out first artistic subject, our first inspiration.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe's history has many dark sides, but its culture is more than a small gleam of hope, it radiates in many areas far out into the world. The old continent sets standards in art, literature and science. Starting with the ancient Greeks, Europe produces a number of smart and creative minds: from Aristotle to Michelangelo and Einstein, from Beethoven to the Beatles.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has been a battle concept for centuries: it often takes foreign enemies to weld the Europeans together. But for centuries, they are primarily fighting against themselves. It was not until the Enlightenment and the French Revolution of 1789 that a new idea of Europe emerged based on common values: freedom, equality and fraternalism.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has never experienced such a long period of peace and prosperity as after the Second World War. When the Iron Curtain falls in 1989, the dream of a Europe united in peace and freedom seems finally to become reality. But whether financial or refugee crisis - the European euphoria has disappeared, nationalists are on the rise again.

programme.title: Wild Sex
programme.desc: Sex is at the heart of everything. It’s the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there’s more than just the act - it’s the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal’s purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Jo and her panel of celebrity fans: Julian Clary, Richard Coles and Rosemary Shrager, discuss the ten bakers and the bread they have baked. What do the panel think of the bakers' rye rolls? How did they fare with the technical challenge - ciabatta? And whose filled centrepiece loaf stood out?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Jo Brand and three celebrity fans highlights from the tent, with chat, unseen footage and an interview with the week's eliminated baker. Comedian Roisin Conaty, chef Glynn Purnell and former contestant Howard Middleton look back at one of the most sensational episodes of Baking Show yet.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: It is pies and tarts week in the tent, so Jo and her panel of celebrity fans: Chef Michel Roux Jr, comedian Shappi Khorsandi and former home secretary Alan Johnson continue the theme in the An Extra Slice studio, looking at audience bakes and viewer photos - the good, the bad and the disastrous.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: It is European cake week in the tent, so Jo and her panel of fans celebrate them by tasting audience bakes and looking at viewer photos of bakes from home - the triumphs and the tragedies. Actress Fay Ripley, comedian Romesh Ranganathan and chef Richard Corrigan are Jo Brand's guests in the studio

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 1 Episode 1
programme.desc: The ten bakers tackle three challenges as their cake making ability is tested. They start with their signature bake - the cake they love that says something about them. Next, is the technical challenge - a blind recipe for Victoria sandwich. Finally, they tackle a chocolate showstopper.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: As the bakers battle it out over biscuits, scones and petit fours, Mel and Sue find out how the digestive became Britain's favourite biscuit, ask what's so Scottish about shortbread and discover why Sir Ranulph Fiennes has the world's most expensive biscuit.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: It's week three and the six remaining bakers are making bread in Kent. And as they battle it out to produce the perfect loaf, Mel and Sue will be tasting Britain's earliest bread roll, finding out what happened to break during the Industrial Revolution and relating the hidden history of the sandwich

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: It's week four and the remaining five bakers travel to Bakewell in Derbyshire. They must reinvent a British classic - the pudding. There are sticky toffee puddings, peach and blueberry 'boy bait', rhubarb and orange betty and a cherry queen of puddings. Can the bakers rise to the occasion?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: It's the penultimate round and the bakers are in the Cornish village of Mousehole, to get to grips with the most difficult of all baking skills - pastry. They make their own version of hearty British pies, produce pastry canapes, and take a crash-course in crimping for this week's surprise bake.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: It's the grand final and the three surviving contestants face their biggest challenge yet - baking for an afternoon tea party. to be crowned the victor they need to bring together their skills making cakes, bread and pastry. Mel and Sue can only present the trophy to one. Wil will it be?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 1 Revisit
programme.desc: Catching up with the bakers to hear the highs and lows of their journey, we learn where they are now and how The Great British Baking Show changed their lives. With contributions from judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, who give their own accounts and memories from the series.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 2 Episode 3

programme.title: Cash Cab
programme.desc: In this offbeat game show, players picked up in the Cash Cab have to answer trivia questions with mounting cash values before they reach their destination in order to win. If a player answers incorrectly three times, he is kicked out of the cab without any money. Help options include a Mobile Shout-Out (phone call) and Street Shout-Out (asking a stranger on the street). Once the player reaches his destination, he can leave the cab with his winnings, if any, or risk them on a more difficult question. A correct final answer doubles his winnings; an incorrect answer means he leaves the cab with no money at all. Comic Ben Bailey takes the cab's wheel as host.

programme.title: Ice Cold Cash
programme.desc: Joe Motiki pedals around on his customized ice cream bike, looking for people who are in the mood for a cold treat but he doesn't have any ice cream, and the bike is just a gimmick. The unsuspecting would-be customers wander right into this food-based trivia game show and instantly become contestants. The questions are about everything from vocabulary and ingredients to food origins and cooking, and witty host Joe keeps them coming as contestants find out just how much they really know about food, their cash prize increasing with each correct answer.

programme.title: Inside the Box
programme.desc: In this game show, three contestants battle it out by answering TV trivia questions for a $10,000 cash prize. In each of the first two rounds, each contestant gets a turn in The Box, a TV-shaped booth, with the other two contestants outside the booth. The contestant in The Box is given a series of questions while the "outside The Box" contestants are given the correct answers. The contestant in the booth asks the other contestants yes or no questions to try to determine the correct answers to the questions being asked. The player with the best score at the end of the second round advances to the final round. In the final round, the contestant asks host Sam Kalilieh yes or no questions in an attempt to correctly answer the question. A correct answer wins the contestant money, based on how long it takes to give the correct answer.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Executioner of God
programme.desc: A former gunman turned priest seeks vengeance on three bandits who are masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: Johnny MaGee arrives in a mining town and clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses underhanded tactics to acquire gold mines. As Burton manipulates the locals, including offering to wipe out a doctor’s debts in exchange for his sister’s marriage, Johnny finds an ally in bounty hunter Ted. But Burton’s reach goes far beyond the mines.

programme.title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
programme.desc: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a massacre in the North seeks revenge. After suffering the atrocity, the Kid executes a solo revenge, razes, beats and kills everyone involved in the massacre.

programme.title: Reverend's Colt

programme.title: Return of Halleluja
programme.desc: In 1860s Mexico, General Ramirez hires American gunfighter Hallelujah to recover a stolen Aztec statue to win indigenous support. But a Scottish adventurer, feuding brothers, bandits, and the army are also in pursuit, turning the hunt into a chaotic race for power.

programme.title: Gunfight at Red Sands
programme.desc: An avenging outsider riddles a gang of ruthless bandits in revenge for the murder of his family.

programme.title: If you meet Sartana... Pray for your Death

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.

programme.title: Renegade Gunfighter
programme.desc: After witnessing his parents’ murder by a ruthless gang, a young man dedicates his life to becoming the fastest gun in the West. Years later, he returns to his hometown, armed with deadly skill and a thirst for vengeance, determined to face the killers who destroyed his family and reclaim his peace.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.

programme.title: Pancho Villa
programme.desc: A double-cross in an arms deal prompts Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa to raid a US Army weapons depot in Columbus, New Mexico.

programme.title: Payment in Blood
programme.desc: In 1867 Texas, after the Civil War, Colonel Thomas Blake and his men refuse to surrender, raiding Yankee towns. Rumors swirl that Blake kills for pleasure, not the Confederacy, leading to large bounties for his capture. However, Blake seeks $200,000 that vanished during the war from Confederate coffers. He sends Chamaco Gonzales to track down the missing fortune, hidden in General Beauregard's strong box.

programme.title: A Coffin for the Sheriff
programme.desc: Spaghetti Western icon Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a mysterious man who joins a ruthless band of highwaymen after overcoming an almost impossible and death-defying initiation.

programme.title: The Restless Breed
programme.desc: After Mitch Baker’s father is killed by gun-runners, he follows them to Mexico for revenge. In the border town of Mission, Texas, Mitch faces off with gang leader Jim Simmons, determined to take justice into his own hands, despite warnings from the sheriff.

programme.desc: In a 1570s convent, a powerful nun uses any means necessary to win a deadly battle for abbess.

programme.title: Call It What You Want
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born (Part 2)

programme.sub-title: Guess Who's Not Going To The Luau
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Prize In Each And Every Package
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Day In The Life Of Oliver Wendell Holmes
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Lisa's Mudder Comes For A Visit
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You And Your Big Shrunken Head
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: The Case Of The Hooterville Refund Fraud
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.sub-title: Beverly Hillbillies: Jed Saves Drysdale's Marriage
programme.desc: Drysdale's marriage is threatened when he looks to the Clampetts for a housekeeper while his wife is away.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.sub-title: The Great Chase in San Francisco
programme.desc: A criminal gang hides a microfilm containing the manufacturing process for artificial diamonds, developed by NASA, in one of Inspector Zenigata's molars.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Forward Hees, the world's richest man, suddenly dies a mysterious death and leaves a large ruby to Fujiko in his will; after inheriting the ruby, Fujiko comes down with the same fever as Hees.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Case of The Risible Dirigible
programme.desc: A Count challenges Lupin to steal a gemstone named Dracula's Tear which is on board his airship, the Hendenburg.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin suffers from transformation sickness, an illness that transforms him into a cruel, cold-blooded criminal at the stroke of midnight.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: An Arab nation receives a blackmail notice; they must pay a $100 million or have their oil fields blown up.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: After capturing the world's largest emerald, Lupin hides it in a museum to retrieve at a later time.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: The Marukin Safe Company is forced into bankruptcy after Lupin cracks open their impenetrable safe; to test his own skills, Marukin's son challenges Lupin to open a safe that he has designed.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: While trying to steal General Hatler's prize medallion, Lupin inadvertently reels in Hatler's biggest secret, his toupee; an enraged General Hatler orders Lupin and his gang to be killed.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Upon returning to Japan, Goemon finds his master on the brink of death; Jinkuro, a fellow disciple, steals half of the scroll containing the secret arts of the Iga Ninja.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin and Jigen are invited to a remote manor full of beautiful women who plan to expose them to aging gas.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: A mysterious woman who claims to be Fujiko's aunt gives Lupin an ultimatum; he must find Marshal Rommel's lost gold or die.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: The great thief Nezumi-Kozou Jirokichi IV appears before Goemon and reveals that their ancestors competed in the first International Thieves Championship together, but were defeated by Lupin's grandfather, Arsène Lupin.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Encounter With the Deadly Iron Lizard
programme.desc: The warden of an African prison holds Fujiko captive; Lupin and his gang infiltrate the prison and attempt to break Fujiko out, but they become the target of the Iron Lizards.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Linda, a beautiful dancer, has stolen Jigen's heart and a vengeful Meyer has taken Fujiko hostage; unaware that Linda and Meyer are working together, Lupin and Jigen are set up to kill each other.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: According to legend, a stamp named the Cinderella Shadow is said to make its owner a princess; Lupin and his gang pull off the heist, but a girl named Alice who also wants the stamp tags along.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin has sent a notice declaring he will steal all the cash from every bank in Paris; Detective Melon, the granddaughter of Inspector Garimard, is chosen to catch Lupin alongside Inspector Zenigata.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: As a master thief, Lupin has many secret techniques up his sleeve and one of them is his levitation technique; a crime syndicate plots a trick, where a fake Lupin tortures a man known as X8 and frames the real Lupin.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Wind in Morocco Is Hot
programme.desc: Lupin and his arch-nemesis Inspector Zenigata are kidnapped and are forcibly conscripted into the French Foreign Legion in Morocco; they end up shackled together and have to work together to make a run for it.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: In Stockholm, twins Latica and Anita constantly fight over who gets to claim the hidden Viking treasure that their father discovered; they each have half of a map that leads to the Viking treasure tattooed on their backs.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: A hit has been ordered on Lupin, and Puma, a formidable hit man, who specializes in long-range attacks, is on his trail; Lupin takes his chances with a one-on-one showdown at close range against Puma.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Orion's Crown has been stolen and is up for grabs at a black-market auction; Lupin has his eyes on the crown and the auction money, but he must outsmart the other parties vying for the crown first.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Lupin Who Turned Into a Vampire
programme.desc: A 2000-year-old casket has been excavated; inside the casket is Camilla, a beautiful woman in a near-death state who holds a golden statuette of the Virgin Mary; Lupin attempts to steal it.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin and his gang are attending a party in Africa, waiting to snatch a rare black pearl; their plan goes awry when a gang of gorillas crashes the party and steals the black pearl.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Uncover the Secret of Tsukikage Castke
programme.desc: Massive riches are hidden inside Tsukikage Castle; Lupin and his gang must decipher a code to find out the whereabouts of the great treasure.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Hidden Gold of Genghis Khan
programme.desc: Lupin and Jigen head to Mongolia in search of Genghis Khan's treasures; Goemon is visiting his ancestors' grave to pay his respects when he encounters Fujiko.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: The ICPO chief promises to erase Fujiko's criminal record in exchange for her cooperation in arresting Lupin.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Diamonds Disappeared Under the Hong Kong Sky
programme.desc: Lupin and Jigen sneak on board a ship smuggling diamonds; what they find on board are several thousand chickens.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin and his gang steal a suitcase containing Costa Rican diamonds, only to find Inspector Zenigata inside the fake shipment; the real diamonds are being shipped to Puerto Rico inside a missile.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Search for the Treasure of Princess Kaguya
programme.desc: While Lupin, Goemon and Jigen are all in Monaco, a beautiful young girl asks all three to bring her one fantastically exotic item.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Onabes' final voyage is nothing short of extravagant with a ship full of beautiful women and fine art; everything goes as planned when Lupin infiltrates the ship disguised as a woman until the bachelor he's trying to rob falls in love with him.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Where Are the Peking Man's Bones
programme.desc: Lupin is in Hong Kong for a vacation when he is asked to find a woman in exchange for help in escaping from Inspector Zenigata.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: The Sleeping Lion, a statue made of solid gold, is being transported to a museum by a specially armored airtight car; Lupin steals the armored car together with the statue.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin manages to steal crime boss Mulligan's precious jewels, only to have them stolen from him by Fujiko; Mulligan, unaware that Fujiko has his jewels, hires a skilled gunman to take them back from Lupin.
